title: The cloud world takes shape
summary: Independent UE 5.7.4 scene development established dynamic cloud generation and recycling, a cloud carpet underfoot, and local fog for depth and orientation.

title: A self-renewing school of fish
summary: Fish now roam on random paths, register touch capture and update a count. Automatic replenishment keeps the world populated, while distant fish are recycled for efficiency.

title: An interface for hearing where fish are
summary: A reusable 3D fish-audio component interface is in place, preparing the project for a future listen-and-locate mode without coupling sound logic to one fish Blueprint.

title: Connect the island to the cloud ocean
summary: The two maps, bathtub portal and one-minute return mechanism remain planned work. They are not yet presented as implemented systems.
